Secrets: never printed; this says only where each would come from.

Doppler: project proj, config dev; `doppler` on PATH

REPEATERBOOK: available (source: doppler)
  RepeaterBook's API token: repeater listings for your own station (D-081)
  REPEATERBOOK is not set; Doppler project proj, config dev is named and `doppler` is on PATH. Doppler is not asked here: the command that needs the secret asks.
  get one: https://www.repeaterbook.com/user/api_apps.php (generate a token for App #114 (RepeaterBook Python Client) on your own account)
  needs the unit: hammunition install repeaterbook-client
  first command: hammunition maps repeaters fetch-repeaterbook --state XX
